notes: EMA Lightning -> LiteRT (https://huggingface.co/litert-community/EMA-Lightning-LiteRT, main 9d7633c79d5588f42fedb26532e09ce9ee205caf, published 2026-10-11; config.json lists every file's sha256 and signatures; the Hub API's LFS sha256 and x-linked-etag read 2026-10-11 equal config.json). Source: canberkkkkkk/ema-lightning (Turkish TTS, 8.6M params: a 5.6M flow-matching DiT distilled to four steps + a 3.0M HiFi-GAN decoder, 48 kHz, Apache-2.0), pip ema-lightning 1.1.2, converted with litert-torch 0.9.4 into four static-shape multi-signature graphs (every bucket a signature sharing the weights). Lane record: /Users/USER/code/litertlm-convert/ema_tts_work/FINDINGS.md (sections 2-6), SPEED_LADDER.md (lint PASS), PRECHECK.md. Harnesses on the Galaxy S26 (serial RFGL80R6A6H, LiteRT 2.2.0, Android 16): (1) the d1_omni lane's debug gate app in generic mode (rows files from make_rows.py name the signature and its inputs as little-endian files; one process per leg; a 'generic' leg runs every fixture row once and is the parity leg, a 'generic_timing' leg runs 3 warm-up calls then 20 timed calls of write inputs + run + read outputs on fixture row 0 on the rested phone: thermal status 0, no CPU cap, GPU idle at 422 MHz before each leg, round p2 19:55-20:00 JST, rounds p3 / p4 20:31-20:38 JST); (2) the Kev lane's C-API runner for the HTP (LiteRT 2.2.0 + the Qualcomm compiler plugin / dispatch libraries, JIT with a cold cache per leg, --accel npu+cpu, BURST; 5 warm-ups then 20 rounds; round n1 20:10-20:31 JST). Parity reference for every S26 row = the same graph on the Mac (ai-edge-litert 2.2.0 XNNPACK, fp32) on the lane fixtures (readme1 / own1 for the acoustic graphs, the decoder windows of all six texts for the decoder); the lane bar is corr >= 0.999 and SNR >= 30 dB on every row and output. Two packagings of the same graphs were measured: the shipped multi-signature files (sha256 of the phone copy = config.json, device/p3/s_graphs.txt and device/p4/s_graphs.txt) in rounds p3 / p4, and the single-bucket fp32 exports of the same signatures (export_graphs.py without --multisig: one signature per file, the same fp32 weights; the lane verified identical outputs on the Mac, out/mixed/verify_fp32_split_multi.json) in rounds p1b / p2 / n1 — each result names the file it ran in `signature`, with the phone copy's sha256 from device/p2/inputs.sha256 / device/n1/s_graphs.txt. Ship assignment per the lane (SPEED_LADDER.md row 5f, FINDINGS.md section 5 round n1), one 3.5 s sentence (readme1: 60 letters, 88 frames = text L64 + align L64/T96 + 4 x step T96 + decoder P48 + P120): text + align on the CPU, the four steps on the HTP, the decoder on the GPU at fp16 = 0.7 + 0.2 + 4 x 1.56 + 14.6 + 31.0 = 52.5 ms (RTF 0.015, first audio 21.7 ms); without the Qualcomm NPU libraries (acoustic graphs on the CPU, decoder on the GPU fp16) 0.7 + 0.2 + 10.0 + 14.6 + 31.0 = 56.5 ms (RTF 0.016, first audio 25.5 ms); everything on the GPU fp32 (split) 1.4 + 0.7 + 12.8 + 22.2 + 54.9 = 92.0 ms (RTF 0.026); everything on the CPU 4 threads 0.7 + 0.2 + 10.0 + 39.1 + 98.8 = 148.8 ms (RTF 0.042, first audio 50 ms) — the per-graph terms are the round p2 rested medians (device/p2/P2_*.json) and the n1 HTP step median; the decoder terms come from the fp32 single-bucket files (the shipped fp16-weight decoder gives the same GPU fp16 figures: 14.6 / 30.5 ms, rounds p3). Records hand-built 2026-10-11 by the session's build_ema_records.py (scratchpad) from the files cited; model-level facts only. This file: one DiT velocity pass (6 layers x 8 heads, d 224; x [1,T,64], cond [1,T,224], bc [1,6,224], sg [1,2,224], fbias [1,1,1,T] -> v [1,T,64]; signatures ema_step_T{48,96,192,384,512}; 530 nodes per signature), called four times per piece with the host's Euler mixing and the 4-row modulation table ema_step_table.npz. The HTP is this graph's fastest home on the phone (1.56 ms per call at 41 dB) and the ship row's step accelerator; GPU default precision sits on the bar for one step (31.1 dB) and the four unrolled steps in fp16 fail (21.0 dB, the unrolled sound graph: see the align record's notes), so the steps run at GPU FP32 or on the CPU where no HTP is available.
quantization: none (fp32 weights; fp16 weights on the DiT failed the lane bar on one of six sentences on the Mac and do not ship)
